description: Forecast the balance of a bank account week by week (13 weeks by default) from its statement — Norma 43 (the Spanish bank format) or a CSV: it detects what repeats (payroll, rent, the self-employed fee, quarterly VAT and other tax and social security payments on their legal calendar), when each comes next, folds what does not repeat into a weekly average, and says the first week the balance goes negative. Prefer `file` to `statement`: it is someone's bank statement, and read from a file it never enters the conversation. The answer has normalised descriptions and weekly totals only, not the transactions.

file.description: Path to the statement file (Norma 43 or CSV)

includeRest.description: Add the weekly average of what does not repeat

minimumBalance.description: Safety balance: also says the first week below it

startingBalance.description: Balance to start from; by default the final balance of the statement (Norma 43 carries it)

statement.description: The statement pasted, if there is no file

name: cash_forecast
title: 13-week cash forecast from a bank statement
